title: Petrol touches record price of Rs 86.25 per litre in Mumbai, diesel at new high
text: Petrol touches record price of Rs 86.25 per litre in Mumbai, diesel at new high Sunday, 2 September 2018 ( 15 hours ago ) Petrol in Mumbai has reached the highest ever rate this morning, making a new record with a price of Rs 86.25 per litre. Diesel too touched a new high of Rs 75.12 per litre. The prices are expected to escalate further, said sources in oil marketing companies. Petrol and diesel prices hit a record new high in four metros across the country on Friday. The prices of both petrol and diesel were raised by the Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) today.
